verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community comment. It shows Milvus offers SQ8 scalar-quantized IVF indexes (IVF_SQ8H, rebuilt from Faiss IVF SQ8), plus another comment noting multiple IVF variants and disk-based search. That points to a built-in quantization capability, but nothing documents memory or storage savings or the accuracy trade-off. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of quantization/compression index types, quantified memory/storage reduction, a documented recall/accuracy trade-off, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can enable vector quantization or compression to cut memory and storage cost with a documented accuracy trade-off

citations.quote: IVF_SQ8H reconstructs Faiss IVF SQ8 with much better performance but requires a GPU.
